item.title: Every Banana Is the Same Banana: What Happens When Everyone Asks One AI?
item.description: What happens when everyone asks one AI? If you buy a banana in a supermarket, it is almost certainly a Cavendish, and every Cavendish is a clone. Bananas grown for export don't come from seeds. Growers plant cuttings, so each plant is a genetic copy of the one before it.
